steps.speaker: Doll
steps.content: Ahhhhhh——!!!
Bone-shattering pain makes the doll let out a heart-wrenching scream...

steps.speaker: Doll
steps.content: Eve! Has gone through a lot!

steps.speaker: Doll
steps.content: You... leave! Take her with you! Take her away! Please!

steps.speaker: Doll
steps.content: Run! Jump! Stand up! Get out!

steps.speaker: Doll
steps.content: A new life!

steps.speaker: Doll
steps.content: A bigger, better world!
This battle has exhausted almost all your strength. Your body is weak and fuzzy, and you can no longer stand up. You can only lie on the ground with the doll, staring at each other.
She seems to have a lot to say to you, but in the end, everything stops at this moment.
As Oliver guessed, if you use your strength again, you will really fall apart. All the cotton in your body has worn out, but an important fragment is right in front of you.
You still decide to crawl towards the doll and reach out...
The spikes of shackles penetrate her plastic body, with the same result as before.
Apart from the intense energy of Mania, there's nothing inside this body. This is just an ordinary doll that has been given personality and will by someone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oliver, I remember you said that Eve's family members are the most special toys here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now I get it. If Pepper and I are humans who got turned into toys, then they are toys who got turned into "humans."

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Huh? Has your head gone bad, too? Why are you speaking in tongue twisters?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve's goal has never been to turn people into toys.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From the very beginning, all she wanted was to make the toys in this factory come alive.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Come alive to act in a corny family soap opera with Eve?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perhaps you're right this time... These weird toys pretending to have identities... It's all just make-believe. A game of playing house.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Her original goal is indeed to "get the toys to play house with her." As for what others will become when they come here, she doesn't care... Cough, cough, cough.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oh... I get it now. So, you're saying they're not like you? That these toy family members are actually dead? That they don't exist?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The horror, the scares, the macabre... These were never Eve's intention. It's just that this is the best she could do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is reality, not a mirage. The effects of her powers are ultimately limited. It's impossible to restore the real happiness and warmth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After all, these toy family members no longer have life.
After listening to your wise and calm analysis, Oliver does not try to be flattering like before, but leans by your ear and whispers...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You know, you're going to be just like them soon...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What... cough, cough, cough!
More and more blood-red cotton gushes from your throat. Along with your last bit of strength, they are spewed out of your body.
Your vision starts to blur. In the dim light, you squint and look up to see an indifferent "I-told-you-so" sneer on Oliver's face.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Open the door! Let me out! Polly! Maresa! Are you outside?
The girl at the door irritably twists the door lock, her wheelchair hitting the door panel again and again.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Another one has been taken away... That new doll wants to destroy everything! I must not let him succeed!
steps.female_content: Another one has been taken away... That new doll wants to destroy everything! I must not let her succeed!

steps.content: The eerie dark mist spreads around Eve and thickens in the room.
The girl suddenly stops and weakly looks back.
Her listless gaze crosses the contaminated dark mist. She looks at the photos and toy designs on the wall, smiles, grits her teeth, musters all her strength, and...
...blasts open the door.
